en.headline: Mid-Autumn holiday crowds fill lantern sites on the day after the festival
en.dek: Victoria Park’s International Lantern Spectacular and other displays continued to draw families on the public holiday, with organisers managing entry to keep queues manageable.
body: Crowds continued to gather at Hong Kong’s main Mid-Autumn lantern sites on Saturday, the public holiday that follows the festival itself.

At Victoria Park the Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s International Lantern Spectacular remained open into the evening. Officials had already shortened entry windows on the festival night itself after long queues formed; similar crowd-control measures remained in place for the holiday.

Other displays, including those at the Cultural Centre Piazza in Tsim Sha Tsui and the Blue House cluster in Wan Chai, also stayed lit. Many families treated the extra day off as a second chance to view the installations after the denser festival-night crowds.
The Observatory kept the Very Hot Weather Warning in force through the day, advising visitors to drink water and take shade breaks while outdoors.

zh.headline: 中秋翌日假期綵燈場繼續熱鬧 維園等人流管理措施維持
zh.dek: 維園世界綵燈大街及其他主要綵燈展在公眾假期繼續開放，主辦單位繼續實施人流管理，方便市民補看。
body: 中秋節翌日公眾假期，本港多個主要綵燈展覽場地繼續吸引市民及旅客到場。
維園的世界綵燈大街由康樂及文化事務署主辦，假期晚上繼續亮燈。中秋夜因人流眾多曾提早截龍，假期期間同樣實施入場人流管理措施，避免過度擠迫。
尖沙嘴文化中心露天廣場及灣仔藍屋建築群等綵燈展亦繼續開放。不少家庭把握假期補看中秋夜因人多而未及細看的展品。
天文台全日維持酷熱天氣警告，提醒市民戶外賞燈時多補充水分及適當休息。
